reason: The prior self-imposed claim gate counted already terminated/recovered jobs as active until public upload, unnecessarily blocking unrelated authorized execution while the UI publication approval was pending.
old_gate: Controller terminal, cleanup and public anonymous readback before slot release.
new_resource_gate: Controller terminal, all exact owned sandboxes independently absent, complete original output recovered and matched to Iris archive SHA. Unknown allocations retain their claim.
public_readiness_gate_unchanged: No public upload until required approval; count public preservation only after fresh anonymous hash/mode readback. Pending traces do not become public by this change.

resources.accounting_correction: Capacity tracks active or uncertain remote resources. Public-release readiness remains a separate gate; no blocked upload is retried or bypassed.
